title: CCJ overview
content:
For internal use only

This page will serve as a datadump for the review of the cybercom hosted jenkins machine. The information here will not be qualified.

These are all the projects on Jenkins.

Which jobs should be moved?

Which jobs have been moved?

Which jobs are no longer needed?

Which jobs are critical but can’t be moved?

Byggis

: Byggis is still used by some of the sofa planners. The base data is coming from this.

Picture taken 18th February 2022

CMS

: Some of the jobs in this folder har still used for publishing data from the Cybercom CMS to Akamai NetStorage. When migrating Storage2 to Github it was decided to not migrate the CMS at the same time, which led to news jobs being created for publishing to the new Akamai root folder structure (starting with 80938…). These jobs have been suffixed with “-new” (not a great suffix, I know). The jobs without the “-new” suffix could be removed (this is valid for AURDAL, BROR, BOAXEL, IVAR, JONAXEL).

: These jobs are used by multiple applications as the CMS has not been migrated:

And these are used specifically by Complete Sleep:

CoRo

Most recent activity: 4+ months ago as of 18th February

CoRo isn’t frequently updated but there is a range update coming in APR22. All the below jobs are still used, as well as the jobs in the CORO NetStorage folder.

Complete Sleep

: We moved to Github Actions for our production build last sprint so these can all be removed.

However we use multiple builds within the CMS category to create and push data to both development and production environments (see CMS heading above).

Possibly unrelated (if we are just talking Jenkins) but we also use https://ikea-aoa-dev.cybercomhosting.com/addon-app/completesleep/ for image deliveries and as a destination for our CMS outputs during development.

IKEA BYOX

: BYOX isn’t getting many updates these days but when there is something that needs to be fixed (like a new locale or new range) it sill relies on most of the above jobs. Everything inside the BYOX legacy folder could be removed though.

IKEA FIRST

Most recent activity: 3+ months ago (as of 18th February)

IKEA-AOA

Most recent activity: 5+ months ago (as of 18th February)

IKEA-ISA

Most recent activity 2+ months ago (as of 18th February)

: Everything except the ELVARLI folder can be removed (all other jobs have been migrated to Github Actions). The ELVARLI folder can be removed as soon as the Storage 2 team is finished with migrating that range to the main platform.

KOMPIS

Most recent activity 3+ months ago (as of 18th February)

NORDLI

Most recent activity 2+ months ago (as of 18th February)

: NORDLI has an EOL set to sometime in March 2022 I think (ask Storage2 PO Stina Nilsson) for details. After that everything here can be removed.
